variants.text: An adult with an oval face, rounded hairline with slight temporal recession, medium arched eyebrows, and almond-shaped eyes.
An adult with an oval face, rounded hairline with slight temporal recession, medium arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes, and a straight-bridged nose with a rounded tip.

Feminine-presenting adult with an oval face, moderate soft tissue, and distinct bone structure. Features include a rounded hairline with slight temporal recession, medium-thickness arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes with visible upper-lid creases, a straight-dorsum nose with a rounded tip, and moderately full lips with a defined cupid's bow. A finger partially occludes the mouth, and the skin is clear.

You can recognize this person by their oval-shaped face, a hairline that slightly recedes at the temples, and medium-thick eyebrows with a soft arch. They have almond-shaped eyes and a straight nose with a rounded tip. Their lips are moderately full, though one of their fingers is partially covering their mouth.
